segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct ElasticEaseInEaseOutAnimation: CustomAnimation { let duration: TimeInterval func animate<V>(value: V, time: TimeInterval, context: inout AnimationContext<V>) -> V? where V : VectorArithmetic { if time > duration { return nil } // The animation has finished. let p = time / duration let s = sin((20 * p - 11.125) * ((2 * Double.pi) / 4.5)) if p < 0.5 { return value.scaled(by: -(pow(2, 20 * p - 10) * s) / 2) } else { return value.scaled(by: (pow(2, -20 * p + 10) * s) / 2 + 1) } } } ```
